module "M_TeleportGlow.dss"

product 0 Material "M_TeleportGlow" backend=Graph settings{BlendMode=Additive, ShadingModel=Unlit, bUsedWithNiagaraSprites=true}
  %0 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L27:C17 "UV"
  %1 = Reflected[VertexColor]() : float4 @L28:C17 "VC"
  %2 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1, 1, 1, 1), Description="Multiplied on top of the particle colour", Group="Glow|Look", ParameterName="Tint", SortPriority=0) : float4 @L6:C1 "Tint"
  %3 = Swizzle(%2, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L30:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %4 = Swizzle(%1, Mask="xyz") : float3 @L30:C34 "EmissiveColor"
  %5 = Multiply(%3, %4) : float3 @L30:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %6 = Reflected[Time]() : float @L30:C56 "EmissiveColor"
  %7 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.1), Description="Amplitude of the slow breathing pulse", Group="Glow|Motion", ParameterName="Breathe", SortPriority=2) : float @L12:C1 "Breathe"
  %8 = Custom[GlowMask](uv=%0, time=%6, breathe=%7, Code="// Begin DreamShader source: <corpus>/IR/Examples/M_TeleportGlow.dss\n// DreamShader custom: GlowMask line 16\n\n    float2 p = uv * 2.0 - 1.0;\n    float r2 = dot(p, p);\n    float glow = pow(saturate(1.0 - r2), 2.4);\n    float hot  = pow(saturate(1.0 - r2 * 2.6), 5.0) * 0.9;\n    float pulse = 1.0 - breathe + breathe * sin(time * 2.1);\n    return (glow + hot) * pulse;\n// End DreamShader source: <corpus>/IR/Examples/M_TeleportGlow.dss\n", Description="GlowMask", OutputType="Float1") : [Result:float] @L30:C43 "EmissiveColor"
  %9 = Multiply(%5, %8) : float3 @L30:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %10 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.7), Description="Overall emissive gain", Group="Glow|Look", ParameterName="Intensity", SortPriority=1) : float @L9:C1 "Intensity"
  %11 = Multiply(%9, %10) : float3 @L30:C23 "EmissiveColor"
  %12 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%11) @L25:C1
  sink %12
